title: Start here: what Mizaj is and what we post
caption:
You've been called 'garam mizaj' your whole life. Time to find out if it's true.

Mizaj brings together two ways of understanding yourself: the 16 Mizaj types (how you think, decide and recharge) and the four Unani temperaments (your natural warmth, energy and mood). Expect shaadi carousels, chai debates, career help for students and a lot of 'yaar, this is literally me'.

Follow along, then tell us: are you here for your type or your mizaj?

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
tiktok_caption: Your type + your mizaj, finally in our language. Start here. #mizaj #mizajpk #personalitytest #pakistan #desi #fyp

reel_hook: 16 types. 4 mizaj. One of them is you.
